effectiveChatFormat: Native nemotron-3-nano renderer selected by the model config and pinned Ollama version.

verification.method: Read-only inspection of the installed manifest/config and version-pinned upstream source; no inference probe.
verification.systemContent: The renderer writes the first system message into the native system role and preserves later system roles. Renderer control strings are excluded by the study request firewall.
verification.thinkingDisabled: With think:false and no in-content control overrides, the renderer emits an empty closed thinking block before generation.
verification.overridePolicy: Reject literal /think or /no_think control strings in any Nano request message before planning or dispatch.

sources.purpose: Select the configured native renderer before the legacy template path.
